requirements.requirement: The system must include a field named enrollment_status_score in each clinical trial object returned by the evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate enrollment_status_score using the value produced by clinical_trials_service without recalculating it in the facade.
The system must preserve all existing fields in the clinical trial response payload unchanged when adding enrollment_status_score.
The system must return enrollment_status_score as a numeric value conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-STATUS-001.
The system must include enrollment_status_score for every trial in the response when the upstream service provides a valid score.
The system must set enrollment_status_score to null when the upstream service does not provide a score for a trial.
The system must not throw an error if enrollment_status_score is missing from the upstream service response.
The system must ensure the response structure remains JSON-serializable after adding enrollment_status_score.
The system must expose enrollment_status_score in the same nesting level as other trial-level evaluation metrics in the payload.
The system must maintain backward compatibility such that clients not expecting enrollment_status_score can still parse the response without failure.
The system must log a warning when enrollment_status_score is null due to missing upstream data.
The system must ensure that adding enrollment_status_score does not increase response latency beyond existing facade performance thresholds.
